questions.question: Paul told Timothy not to rebuke an older man in the church. What should Timothy do instead?

answers.text: Appeal to him as to a father
Let the other elders handle it
Wait for him to notice himself

questions.question: Paul said a widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope where?
Paul said anyone who does not provide for his own household is worse than an unbeliever. True or false?
Paul told Timothy not to enroll younger widows for church support. What did Paul advise them to do instead?

answers.text: Stay single and serve the church
